sentences.text:
The petitioner feeling aggrieved by an order dated 20.11.2024 suspending the license granted to
him under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has preferred the instant writ petition.
2.  Learned Standing Counsel, on basis of written instructions, submits that, since, there was no improvement found during re-inspection, therefore, the suspension order has been kept alive.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has alternative remedy of challenging the suspension order by filing appeal under Section 32(5)(a) of the Act.

sentences.text: 1 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for liberty to approach the appellate authority.
4. In case, appeal is filed within two weeks from today, it shall be decided on merits.
5. Accordingly, the petition stands disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to avail the said remedy.

(Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 30.7.2025 Ankit.
